name: Jacobs Brook Campground
note: About half seasonal: the operator's site map marks 27 of its roughly 60 numbered sites 'All Season', and the rest are sold by the night (5 also by the month) or are tent sites. The operator asks RVs to skip the 3-ton Archertown Road bridge and follow the truck detour by Dublin Road. Jacobs Brook's swimming holes are a trail walk from the RV loops. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site jacobsbrookcampground.biz (read 2026-11-23; jacobsbrookcampground.com 301s to it; page build stamp 2026-06-03): 75 campsites, pull-thru and water/electric/sewer RV sites, 'Water & Electric Only - 48/night', open May 15 - Oct 15, reservations by phone/email form; operator site map (image 134579176.png) marks green 'Nightly RV Water, Electric' (~21, 4 of them listed as future sites), blue 'Nightly - Monthly RV Water, Electric, Sewer' (5), yellow 'All Season' (27), 6 tent and 3 cabins -> roughly half the sites sold by the night (passes test 4; no application, lease or standing minimum; 3-night minimum only on holiday weeks); Google Maps 4.5 on 58 reviews with the same phone (gm.py 2026-11-23); RV Life 4.5*/$$$ avg $43; Campendium 2021 review: 37-ft travel trailer on site 51. Price gate: cheapest RV night $48 (W/E) <= US$50 -> PASS (no gateway within 40 km; not needed). Real private transient RV campground.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery + USGS NHD flowlines (hydro.nationalmap.gov layer 6) overlaid, read 2026-11-23: Jacobs Brook runs along the south and west edges of the property; the RV loops (centre ~43.8970,-72.1183) sit ~110 m from the brook at their nearest (south loop edge) and the open group/grass area ~100 m from it, both across a continuous forest band with no view of the water. The operator site map shows the brook reached by foot trails ('Hessie's Path', 'Phil's Trail') past tent-only sites 41-45 and the planned site 62. No RV pad within ~50 m of the brook or with a sightline to it -> not waterfront. Jacobs Brook is a small stream (well under 30 m wide), so creekside would be the most it could be, and no RV site meets it.

fees.note: Water + electric $48; water, electric + sewer $53; 50-A full hookup $60. Tent sites $30 (water only) and $38 (water + electric, 20-A max); group tent area $35 per site. Rate covers 2 adults and 3 children; additional persons charged.

fees_source: https://jacobsbrookcampground.biz/campsites.html/ (read 2026-11-23, page build 2026-06-03): 'Water & Electric Only - 48/night', 'Water, Electric & Sewer - 53/night', 'Water, 50amp Electric & Sewer - 60/night', 'Monthly Water & Sewer Sites With Metered Power', 'Prices are subject to change'; tent 'Including Water & Electric - $38/night', 'Water Only ... $30/night', 'Group Area ... $35/night per site'; 'maximum of 2 adults, and three children ... We will charge any additional persons accordingly.' Wayback captures 2024-11-04 and 2025-05-23 show the earlier $40/$48/$53 tiers.

booking.note: Reservations by phone or the operator's web form/email; replies within 48 hours. The 3-night minimum covers the Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weeks.

booking_source: https://jacobsbrookcampground.biz/reservations.html/ and /campground-policies.html/ (read 2026-11-23): 'Call or email for reservations ... If you leave a message or send an email, we will contact you within 48 hours.' 'There is a three-night minimum stay for all holiday weeks (Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day)'.
sites_source: https://jacobsbrookcampground.biz/ (read 2026-11-23): 'Our campground in Orford, NH, boasts 34 acres of untouched wilderness with 75 campsites.' (The operator's site map numbers about 62 sites plus a group area.)
hookups_source: https://jacobsbrookcampground.biz/campsites.html/ (read 2026-11-23): 'We equip all sites with electricity, water ...'; 'Water, Electric & Sewer - 53/night'; 'Water, 50amp Electric & Sewer - 60/night'. Home page: 'SITES 1 THRU 7 have NOW 50/30 amp and sewer'.
facilities_source: https://jacobsbrookcampground.biz/rv-sites.html/ and /campsites.html/ (read 2026-11-23): 'Dumping Station', 'Clean Rest Rooms', 'Showers (metered to conserve energy)'; 'All sites are equipped with water'; 'The dumping station is located conveniently at our exit'. Flush toilets not stated, so left out.
season_source: https://jacobsbrookcampground.biz/rv-sites.html/ (read 2026-11-23): 'Weather permitting, our reserved campsites are open up to the public on May 15th and remain open until October 15th every year.' 2027 dates not separately posted.
flags: Nightly share sits right at the 50% line: from the operator's map (image on the live site, first captured 2022-09-02, so possibly dated), nightly-only green sites ~21 (the reservations page says 16, 22, 35, 62 and a new 44 are planned future water-only sites, not booked now), nightly-or-monthly 5, tent 6, All Season 27, cabins 3. Existing nightly + tent ~27-32 of ~55-59 -> about 46-54% nightly; kept with the 'about half seasonal' caveat (AWH 2026-11-12 band).

Access: the operator says 'PLEASE TAKE DUBLIN ROAD INSTEAD OF ARCHERTOWN RD DUE TO THE BRIDGE NOT ALLOWING OVER 3 TONS ACROSS IT..FOLLOW TRUCK DETOUR SIGNS' - EKKO (~5.5 tons) must use the detour; an alternative route is named, so kept with the note line.

Price passes narrowly ($48 W/E site, $50 gate); reviews strong (Google 4.5 on 58, RV Life 4.5). RV Life tags it $$$ (avg_rate 43). The 2025 page (Wayback 2025-05-23) had W/E at $40, so the 2026 rate rose $8.
Not a Good Sam Park: Good Sam lists it as a 'Verified Campground' only (gsr.py name match returned a different park).

Operator site states 'We recently purchased Jacobs Brook Campground' and the 2026 page mentions July and September events - operating in 2026. RoverPass and CamplinQ listings are unclaimed directory copies (CamplinQ carries old 2022 text with $40 + $5 electric surcharge) - not used.

Pin moved from the Good Sam point 43.89788,-72.11966 (by the office/entrance, ~130 m NW) to the RV loops. Not a duplicate: nothing in campgrounds.json by name; nearest entry 4143 The Pastures Campground is 1.84 km NW on the Connecticut River with its own phone 603-353-4579.
